annotations.title: Turn Photon extra usage on or off

description: Turn Photon extra usage on or off for a site. On: compression continues past the included volume, billed per extra GB. Off: stops at the included volume. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

enabled.description: true turns it on, false off.

serviceId.description: Service id of the website or service (from oma_read_services).

name: oma_photon_set_overage
